scope: Full current native/Python regression, missing-value histogram optimization, and lower physical peak on very wide training; Python bindings only.
hardware: Apple M3, 10-core GPU, 8 CPU cores, 16 GiB unified memory

baseline_full_coverage.scope: Complete baseline standard suite across initial5passed groups, repaired sketch group, remaining100groups and all Python tests. Initial pre-injection timeout preserved; readiness fix keeps5second fault deadline. Controlled6second startup delay also passed.

regression_harness.reason: One worker spent about 16 seconds preparing its first GPU buffer; the other timed out at the readiness barrier, before deliberate disconnect. Tracker and collective fault deadlines were five seconds.
regression_harness.fix: Prepare each worker payload before starting the tracker and communicator. Do not increase the five-second fault timeout or weaken failure assertions.
regression_harness.delay_proof: Both deliberate-disconnect cases passed with one worker delayed six seconds before startup, while the fault deadline remained five seconds.

cache_test_repair.cause: The new concurrent-reader test used vector(Data().begin(), Data().end()). XGBoost SpanIterator requires both iterators to belong to the same Span object; its owner assertion terminated after the histogram completed. Store one span before copying. No backend assertions or tolerances were relaxed.
